$comment: Every public address and endpoint on Ethereum Sepolia, in the shape of arc-testnet.json and under its rules: public values only, and `null` means NOT DEPLOYED. Every address below was read on chain on 2026-11-05.

usdc.$comment: Circle's Sepolia USDC (symbol() and decimals() read on chain); faucet.circle.com hands it out. Unlike Arc, ETH pays gas here.

create2Factory.$comment: The deterministic deployment proxy (Arachnid, keyless, the same address on every EVM chain). Code read on Sepolia on 2026-11-05.

accounts.$comment: The attester is made in docs/mumbai/PLAN.md T4, with FORS keys of its own: never Arc's, which are few-time.

erc4337.$comment: All three EntryPoints have code on Sepolia, and Pimlico's keyless endpoint serves them (eth_supportedEntryPoints, chain 0xaa36a7, checked 2026-11-05).

mesh.$comment: Sepolia's own relay directory root, from a master Arc never uses. Filled in by `node scripts/new-mesh-master.ts eth-sepolia` (in backend/), which keeps the master in backend/.stack/eth-sepolia/mesh-master.

services.$comment: Endpoints, not keys. Each is null until that service is hosted.

swap.$comment: LI.FI has no testnets, so there is no router here yet. Uniswap v4's Universal Router takes its place in docs/mumbai/PLAN.md T8.
